_comment: Numbers the page renders. Upload a new copy of this file and the page
updates — no HTML change, no redeploy of anything else.
`decode` is a best recorded rate on that machine, or null for 'not
measured'. Null renders as 'not measured' rather than a blank or a zero,
because a missing measurement and a slow one are different claims.
`modes` is how the model runs there: gpu = fully resident, ssd = experts
stream from disk, hyb = split CPU/GPU. Several modes means the app can
use any of them; an empty list renders 'does not fit'.
_provenance: Carried over verbatim from the first version of this page. NOT yet re-verified against the app's RunHistory store, which is not present on the machine this was edited from. Replace with exported measurements before treating these as current.

boxes.label: M1 Ultra · 64-core GPU · 128 GB
boxes.note: Best decode recorded on this machine, each model on the engine the app picks for it — llama.cpp for the dense-ish Qwen, our own Rust/Metal engine for the four big MoEs. The last two rows are out-of-core rates: neither model fits 128 GB, so the weights stream from disk and the cost is visible in the number.

boxes.label: M2 Max · 64 GB
boxes.note: The same catalogue, scored for 64 GB. Laguna-S still fits in memory; DeepSeek-V4-Flash no longer does and moves out-of-core, which is what the 2.9 costs — the same file, a different machine, a different answer.

boxes.label: M4 mini · 16 GB
boxes.note: A 16 GB Machine is offered the models that suit it, not the whole catalogue — the 87 GB and 217 GB entries are scored, flagged and left out of reach rather than dangled. Only the first row has been run here; the app will not print a rate it has not measured on the machine in front of you.
